title: Shared API, authorization and transport rules
summary: Cross-feature service and transport invariants. These are separately identifiable contract/operational cases, not a claim that one generic test proves every endpoint.

cases.title: Reject anonymous protected read
preconditions: An isolated authorized environment is available with the described account, collection or configured endpoint state.
steps: Read a protected business endpoint without usable authentication.
expected: A protected failure is returned without business data.
notes: Shared invariant: apply to the relevant operation set when designing later tests; this entry alone is not per-operation coverage.

cases.title: Maintenance service identity
preconditions: An isolated authorized environment is available with the described account, collection or configured endpoint state.
steps: Call the configured maintenance endpoint with an allowed verified Google service-account token and empty body.
expected: The bounded maintenance operation runs with a no-store response.
notes: Shared invariant: apply to the relevant operation set when designing later tests; this entry alone is not per-operation coverage.

Managed-provider acceptance requires an actual verified Google service-account token from the intended test service. Local fake-verifier unit checks are separate evidence and cannot verify this REST/operator journey. The real configured missing-credential boundary is UC-SYS-0029.
